description: This source file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer utility in the OpenClaw project, checking environment variable sanitization, inspection, and override handling.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: A test suite for HostEnvSanitizer, containing multiple test functions validating environment sanitization behavior.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests sanitization of environment variables related to shell tracing, ensuring certain variables are cleared or retained.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified keys are allowed during sanitization when shellWrapper is true.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Checks that overrides are preserved in non-shell mode.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Ensures that the inspection correctly identifies blocked and invalid override keys.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Tests that Windows-style environment variable keys are accepted and retained in sanitization.
